fact: The Addis Ababa City Administration announced a new AI-enriched digital civil registration and resident services system, to begin operations in 50 woredas the following Monday.
system: AI-enriched integrated digital civil registration and resident services system

fact: Addis Fortune reports that the Ministry of Revenues and the Ethiopian Customs Commission unveiled eight digital systems on 12 October 2025, including an AI-based Customs Chatbot.
University World News says the Ethiopian Media Authority this year introduced the use of an AI system to try to eradicate misinformation and hate speech.

University World News names AI in use at both the Ethiopian Media Authority (misinformation monitoring) and the National Election Board (election planning and registration), two bodies in different sectors.
system: Media Authority AI system; Election Board AI tools
